package: SLO1040H series molded SMD power inductor, 2-terminal, body 10.8 x 10.0 x 4.0mm(max)
description: Sunltech SLO1040H6R8MTT - 6.8uH magnetically-shielded, molded (iron-powder core) SMD power inductor. Datasheet Rev.01, 4 pages, source_pdf=parts/C207852.pdf.

pinout.name: Terminal A
pinout.notes: Non-polarized inductor terminal. Datasheet gives no pin numbering, pin-1 mark, or start-of-winding indicator anywhere in the 4 pages - '1'/'2' assigned arbitrarily for schematic reference only. Either terminal may connect to the switch node or the filtered-output side.

pinout.name: Terminal B
pinout.notes: Non-polarized inductor terminal; see Terminal A notes. Top-side ink marking (e.g. '2R2', '1R0', '4R7' seen in the page-1 product photos) encodes only the inductance value/decimal-point code, not orientation.

land_pattern.package: SLO1040H body/terminal outline (page 1 'Dimensions' drawing + table) - NOT a dedicated recommended-PCB-land-pattern drawing; this datasheet does not contain one.
land_pattern.notes: Page 1 'Dimensions' table for the SLO1040H series gives only the body/terminal outline: A(length)=10.8+-0.2mm, B(width)=10.0+-0.2mm, C(height)=4.0mm max, D+-0.1mm=3.0mm, E+-0.1mm=2.0mm. D and E are dimensioned on a stepped side-view drawing at the terminal end and are the closest available figures to a pad size (interpreted as terminal-region length x width; the datasheet does not caption D/E with a text label, so this is an interpretation of the drawing, not a stated 'pad size'). pad_size_mm=[D,E]=[3.0,2.0] in that order. Pad-to-pad pitch/spacing is NOT stated anywhere in the 4-page datasheet and is not reliably derivable from A/D without an explicit reference dimension (the sourcer's/part.json overall package note '10.8x10mm' matches A x B, i.e. the whole-body footprint, not a pitch). Recommendation for the layout step: treat D x E as a minimum terminal size, add standard toe/heel/side copper margin, and place the two pads within the A=10.8mm x B=10.0mm body envelope near each end - this is a layout judgment call, not a vendor-specified footprint.

layout_notes: Magnetically shielded, molded construction using magnetic iron-powder core (page 1, Features #1-2) - vendor markets this as suited to placement near other components with reduced stray-field coupling vs. open/unshielded types; no quantitative shielding/stray-field figure is given.
Frequency range up to 3.0MHz (page 1, Feature #5) - informational for switching-frequency selection, not a placement/routing constraint.

Part temperature (ambient + temperature rise) must not exceed 150C under the worst-case operating condition; vendor states circuit design, component placement, PWB trace size/thickness, airflow, and other cooling provisions all affect part temperature and it 'should be verified in the end application' (page 2, Note 5). Relevant to this board's ~90C hotspot at 50C ambient - see OPEN for the operating-temperature-range discrepancy.
No PCB land-pattern/footprint drawing is provided by the vendor - only the body/terminal outline (page 1). See land_pattern.notes.
No terminal polarity, pin-1, or start-of-winding marking is specified anywhere in the datasheet; component is a non-polarized 2-terminal passive.

Reflow soldering: at least 50% of the terminal electrode should be covered by new solder (page 4, Reliability table 'Reflow soldering' row) - useful as a solder-joint QA/AOI check on this 3A terminal.

Resistance-to-solder-heat / solder-ability tests require at least 75% terminal-electrode solder coverage (page 4) - stricter than the reflow-only figure above; both are vendor QA acceptance criteria, not design limits.
Wave soldering profile: preheat >150C over 2min, peak 260C solder within 10sec, gradual cooling (page 3 diagram).
Hand soldering profile: preheat >150C over 2min, peak 280C within 3sec (soldering step 230C within 10sec), gradual cooling (page 3 diagram).
